uncertaintyKind: Published uncertainty on SAGE-based thermophysical diameter; not the total uncertainty of transferring that size to a different convex mesh.
diameterSemantics: Volume-equivalent diameter147±2km from Alí-Lagoa et al.2020Table2 (SAGE1, HerschelPACS). The selected DAMIT16321 is a different convex model, so using this physical scale is explicitly approximate.
reference: Alí-Lagoa et al.(2020), A&A638,A84, Table2, doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202037718; SAGE model reference Podlewska-Gaca et al.(2020), A&A638,A11
limitations: Published147±2km uncertainty belongs to the SAGE1thermophysical solution, not a scale fit to DAMIT16321. Neither SAGE mirror pole was rejected by the thermaldata.
